barrel-king.name: Grumpy Barrel King
barrel-king.blurb: Googly-eyed barrel boss. Soft corks only — all ages.
barrel-king.winText: Your allies tip the Barrel King into a hug-roll. It declares you champions and rolls aside.
barrel-king.loseText: The Barrel King bonks you with a soft cork — then yawns and rolls aside anyway. Fail-forward!
